assertions.assertion: Output registers health checks using builder.Services.AddHealthChecks()
Output adds AddDbContextCheck<ConfigurationDbContext> and AddDbContextCheck<PersistedGrantDbContext> tagged with a 'ready' tag
Output maps /health/live with a Predicate that runs no checks (_ => false) so the liveness probe only confirms IdentityServer middleware is running
Output maps /health/ready with a Predicate filtering on the 'ready' tag
Output does NOT rely on custom IHealthCheck classes that invoke the discovery/JWKS endpoint handlers via IEnumerable<Hosting.Endpoint>
assertions.rationale: Uses only built-in DbContext checks; explicitly advises against custom IHealthCheck calling discovery handlers.
